name: Boo.com
title: Was Boo.com too early? No: Net-a-Porter won the same year
question: Was Boo.com too early for online fashion?
answer: Boo.com spent about $135M in six months building a heavy 3D fashion store and collapsed in May 2000. Net-a-Porter launched online luxury fashion that same year, on the same bandwidth, and became a lasting business. The enabler existed; the execution did not.
verdict_reason: Net-a-Porter launched online fashion in 2000 and succeeded.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.
